caption: The drawing features a rectangular field with a grey background filled with evenly spaced white polka dots. Superimposed on this background are four clusters of flowers, each predominantly composed of white petals with yellow centers and green stems and leaves. The flower clusters are situated near the top left, top right, center, and bottom right of the grey field. The clusters are painted with visible brushstrokes and differing arrangements, with the green foliage varying in size and direction. The grey field is surrounded by a slightly yellowed off-white border, with a visible signature in pencil on the lower right corner of the border. There is a small orange stain on the right edge of the border.
